en.headline: Police hold four over alleged 70 million dollar mortgage fraud
en.dek: Commercial crime officers said three men and a woman were arrested on Tuesday over fake payroll records used to obtain loans on one flat.
body: Police said the Commercial Crime Bureau arrested three men and a woman on Tuesday on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud, alleging they used false payroll records and forged documents to obtain more than 70 million dollars in mortgage loans on one residential property from three financial institutions.

A senior inspector of the bureau said the suspects were aged 30 to 42 and reported working as estate agents, a company director and a nurse. Investigators believe that between 2021 and 2023 the applicants, with associates, set up shell companies to create false salary records and employment proofs, inflating income so lenders would treat them as able to repay.

Officers searched several premises, including company offices and the arrested people's homes, and seized mobile phones, computers, company papers and chops used to make false documents. The four were detained for further inquiries. Police said they did not rule out further arrests, and that conspiracy to defraud can carry up to 14 years in prison on conviction.
The four have been arrested and have not been convicted. Police said they would continue financial inquiries and keep exchanging intelligence with the industry and regulators.

zh.headline: 商罪科拘4人 涉以假出糧紀錄騙取逾7000萬元按揭
zh.dek: 警方稱周二拘捕3男1女，涉嫌為一個住宅物業向三間金融機構申請按揭，並以空殼公司製造虛假出糧紀錄。
body: 警方商業罪案調查科表示，周二以串謀詐騙罪拘捕3男1女，涉嫌利用虛假出糧紀錄及偽造文件，為一個住宅物業向三間金融機構申請按揭，騙取合共超過7000萬元貸款。
商罪科高級督察表示，被捕人年齡由30歲至42歲，分別報稱地產經紀、公司董事及護士。調查指，2021年至2023年期間，申請人為符合金融機構的入息要求，透過同夥開設空殼公司，製造虛假出糧紀錄及工作證明，誇大收入，令機構誤以為申請人有還款能力而批出貸款。
行動中，警方搜查多個處所，包括相關公司辦公室及被捕人住所，檢獲手提電話、電腦、公司文件，以及用以製造虛假文件的印章。四人仍被扣留調查，警方不排除進一步拘捕。警方指串謀詐騙屬嚴重罪行，定罪後最高可判監禁14年。
四人目前只是被捕，尚未被法庭定罪。警方表示會繼續財務調查，並與金融業界及監管機構加強情報交流。
